root_cause.summary: Transport forward sync only watched logs/signals_ftmo_demo2.jsonl. Any producer that appended only to logs/signals.jsonl (aggregate log) never reached the Windows MT5 file unless manually copied or duplicated into the canonical file.
root_cause.signals_ftmo_demo2_intent: Producer may write directly OR transport derives it automatically from the aggregate log; both are valid if dedupe is consistent.
root_cause.signals_jsonl_intent: Broader structured signal / event log (dashboard and API read paths); not sufficient alone for EA consumption on Windows without derivation.

chosen_contract.aggregate_optional: logs/signals.jsonl may receive all emitted lines including TOP3-style; Windows transport derives bridge_account=ftmo_demo2 lines into the canonical stream before forward sync.
chosen_contract.no_manual_append: fxg_win_derive_canonical_ftmo_from_signals_jsonl.ps1 runs in the canonical transport loop.
